nodes.title: Serve the app on port 8000 bound to 0.0.0.0
nodes.summary: The Vite config sets no server or preview options, so the app uses Vite's defaults (localhost on port 5173 for dev and 4173 for preview). This goal sets the server and preview host to 0.0.0.0 and the port to 8000 in the Vite config and the npm scripts. Existing behaviour stays the same. It covers the 'prepare for deploy-manager' part of [fb_8d5f5129-e787-442e-867e-20b06fb1657e].

nodes.title: Add a root Dockerfile that builds and runs the app
nodes.summary: The repository has no Dockerfile. This goal adds a Dockerfile at the repository root that installs dependencies, builds the Vite app and starts it on port 8000 bound to 0.0.0.0. It also adds a .dockerignore to keep the build context small. The image must not need privileged mode, the Docker socket or extra capabilities, and it must stay within the 512m memory, 1 CPU and 256 process limits. It covers the 'prepare for deploy-manager' part of [fb_8d5f5129-e787-442e-867e-20b06fb1657e].

nodes.title: Write a README with run and deploy instructions
nodes.summary: The repository has no README. This goal adds a README.md at the repository root. It describes what system-tracker is, how to install, run and build it, and how to run it in the container on port 8000. It also notes the deploy-manager requirements the project meets: a root Dockerfile, port 8000 on 0.0.0.0, and no privileged mode. It covers the README request in [fb_8d5f5129-e787-442e-867e-20b06fb1657e].
